Assisted Living in Springfield

Assisted living at Maple Grove Senior Living gives Springfield seniors daily support without giving up independence. Residents keep their own apartments and routines. Licensed staff help with medication, bathing, and dressing whenever help is wanted. Families get a partner they can reach at any hour of the day.

Personalized Care Plans

Our nurses write a care plan with each resident before move-in day. The plan covers medication schedules, mobility support, and personal goals. It is reviewed every ninety days with the family.

Overview

Residents enjoy chef-prepared meals, weekly housekeeping, and a full calendar of outings around Springfield.

Amenities at Maple Grove

  • Chef-prepared meals served three times daily in the dining room
  • Weekly housekeeping and linen service for every apartment
  • Scheduled transportation to Springfield appointments and shopping
  • Secure courtyard garden with raised planting beds

Frequently Asked Questions About Cost

Maple Grove Senior Living charges one monthly fee that covers rent, meals, housekeeping, and scheduled transportation. Care services are billed in four levels, and our team reassesses the level with families each quarter. Most residents pay between four and six thousand dollars per month depending on apartment size and care level. Veterans benefits and long-term care insurance can offset part of the fee, and the billing office helps families file both. A refundable deposit holds an apartment for up to thirty days while a family decides. Respite stays are offered by the week when a caregiver needs a break, and those stays include the same meals, housekeeping, and care services that long-term residents receive every day.
